note: Copied from data/vocab/words.json (roots and binyan labels come from its dictionary source, not checked by a Hebrew teacher; some links are loose). Unreviewed. A verb is listed in the explorer only when it has a pattern (binyan), at least one listed form, and either a frequency rank of 5000 or better or a place in a root family of two or more words (any part of speech). Verbs that fail that rule stay in the word-list totals and are not browsable in the explorer.
